subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata attempt-result contract and server_error retry-before-failover behavior, or choose another linked candidate as the canonical fix?
rationale: The code shape is plausible and source-backed, but it changes retry/session/message-delivery semantics and an exported attempt result shape, and multiple open candidate PRs target the same issue.

options.title: Accept after proof and conflict refresh
options.body: Require a conflict-free head plus redacted real gateway or full-runner proof, then proceed with this current-attempt metadata contract if the semantics still review cleanly.

options.title: Use the sibling candidate
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 as the canonical landing path if maintainers prefer its proof or mergeability state after fresh review.

options.title: Reject this contract shape
options.body: Ask for a different current-attempt side-effect signal if maintainers do not want a new optional attempt-result metadata field.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and conflict refresh
recommendation.body: Require a conflict-free head plus redacted real gateway or full-runner proof, then proceed with this current-attempt metadata contract if the semantics still review cleanly.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is closest to prior structured terminal-state and replay-provenance work in the embedded runner area.
